notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IH40AZzul10;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/8761811f6c62c7b22ccee3927ebd3402fece672d.png[/img]


[b][h3]■The evil overlord who awakened to the power of darkness[/h3][/b]
　The Dark Shaker (real name: Barten Skyshaker), the eleventh new fighter to be added to the lineup, is a fighter with a fluttering black cloak, wielding a sword covered in energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/0a5f7fcb07d4845ae3bc952434ff07327aca886c.png[/img]


　Awakened by the power of darkness, he hunts down and overwhelms any enemy. He's an evil overlord who leads many Shakers.


[b][h3]■The Dark Shaker is a subskill. [/h3][/b]
　When the Dark Shaker activates his subskill, he releases an energy ball that condenses the power of darkness. The Dark Shaker's sub-skill activates an energy ball that condenses the power of darkness, and although it's not very fast, it can homing the opponent and slowly chase them down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/1204e9dc44ac5a468a9509d27f33a7df1802dac1.png[/img]


　The ball of darkness explodes when it hits the opponent. Although it doesn't have a guard break, it will continuously explode when guarded, and can even hold the opponent in place for a short while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/0c6a729eb7864d905e10abc5db6dc52897fc8a9f.png[/img]


[b][h3]■Main Skill with Powerful Derivative Moves[/h3][/b]
　The main skill is a technique that uses the power of darkness to quickly dash in a specified direction. While dashing, you are not invincible, but you can move a long distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/1b0866dda725c62e51a6a172a5aad474bbd8d4f9.png[/img]


　If you use the main skill again after the main skill, the skill will derive and perform a forward guard break attack. This can be used as a finishing blow to a cornered enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/40e4a2450dbd4e00860bdff3879dd6526a9aa6e3.png[/img]


　When derived from a sub-skill, the power of darkness travels through the ground and attacks the opponent from the feet up. This powerful blow will never let your opponent escape, no matter how far away you are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/4dbe8e4db3c2b91df4355336b3d9f9f2c52f9025.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/da8cc2515d22885beb38e8e3d66bcf55a2dacdc2.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=eIcyKTwoDQ0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]■An emperor who uses materialized "Chasers" to fight!  [/h3][/b]

 Boss Brandy, the tenth new fighter to be added to the game, is an intimidating fighter who uses two types of powerful "Chasers" to fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/d9282670aa01de481142fe341e1f3754d9bdf20a.png[/img]

 Unlike other fighters, his greatest feature is the nature of his sub and main skills, which change depending on how many skill points he has left.  

 

[b][h3]■You can use special actions to increase your skill points!  [/h3][/b]

 If you use a skill while on guard, you can increase your skill points by one. It will leave you defenseless for a little while, but as "Boss Brandy" has powerful skills, you'll definitely want to take advantage of it.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/4716888a2d9dd474750d252d4bb0f941f063421c.png[/img]

 The ability to increase skill points with special actions is quite powerful, but be aware that in return, skill points cannot be accumulated with normal attacks except for the third shot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/2edbff69ae242a64719d32a8b7af95f7eb745f9e.png[/img]

[b][h3]■A variety of skills that change with the amount of skill points remaining . [/h3][/b]

 In "Boss Brandy", both the main and sub skills change depending on how many skill points are left. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/29ea29facd1055a4b106710cb99f070d78607888.png[/img]

 The sub-skill allows you to attack your opponent with a spiritual body called a "Chaser", but the number of moves and range of the attack changes depending on how many skill points you have left.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/481bf5a88c0d2d79a91914af18ffe0d4e59de7ab.png[/img]

 In the main skill, if you have 1 or 2 skill points, you can perform an evasive maneuver to move a short distance while remaining invincible. It is best to use it when you expect your opponent to counterattack.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/d01b4791c1810250c47e78c21e542867a8314b4e.png[/img]

notes.title: New fighter participation! (ver.1.9)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OBgrerpvHs8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/a97abf9bd2bdca1641ddf43429b6ef5f9aa0ed32.png[/img]

[h3][b]■Charge and fire![/b][/h3]

 　The ninth new fighter to be added to the game is Space Beer, who has come from outer space with a giant battleship. This time, he seems to have come all the way back from space to reign as the pinnacle of drinks in both name and reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/121f0830cc0f4bcf75fb23dccd41ba53531a8b53.png[/img]

　One of his arms has been transformed into a beer gun using ultra-high technology, and the blow from it is unimaginably powerful.


[h3][b]■Three levels of sub-skills that change as you recharge[/b][/h3]
The sub-skills in Space Beer can be recharged by holding down the button, and the attacks fired will increase in strength in three stages depending on the recharge time. When the subskill is at maximum charge, it is so powerful that it can even penetrate the opponent's guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/237c9587d79bd0fff99e33c396fe299952497ce3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/ad99224c55e0756c6891fbd4fd1eb672dd0f6119.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/716b9072304feee2c09bd675db0eb4c7ea52cff0.png[/img]

　It can also be canceled by guarding during a sub-skill, and you can keep the amount you charged during that time. It's a good idea to save up a little at a time in a safe place and build up to the maximum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/157bf4817aeee70f55c0e9d5baedd20009934ca3.png[/img]
　

[h3][b]■The main skill is to call for backup from space![/b][/h3]
　The main skill is to request support from the space battleship, and it will perform a lightning attack on the targeted opponent. The lightning attack lasts until it hits the opponent (up to five times).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/d822ceeddc6cef7e5099d26bb91b1dbf979ffa57.png[/img]

　If used while under attack, the lightning bolt will strike you and damage any nearby opponents. Super Armor will be added at this time.

[b][h3]■A hammer-using jar that bounces around lightly! [/h3][/b]
　The eighth addition to our lineup of new fighters is Black vinegar, who uses a hammer to bounce around with ease! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/931cb97b1996afa82c895e76d5d75dca75344a12.png[/img]

 　His hobby is mountain climbing, and he has even reached outer space after mastering it too much. He uses his exceptional physical abilities to bounce around and fight with a hammer swinging style that moves back and forth, left and right with ease. 

 
[b][h3]■Let's jump and get around lightly! [/h3][/b]
　The new fighter, Black vinegar, can jump in any direction with its main skill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/a8fee173552564bb059882c7a2d46b6fab818961.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/9abbc89cf13ecd0d9de71a58772c3b0124b9352f.png[/img]

　The new fighter, Black Vinegar, can jump in any direction with his main skill. When he lands, he can make a mark on the ground, and if he dashes within this mark, it will turn into a dash attack where he attacks while spinning his hammer. This can be used to counterattack immediately after avoiding an opponent's attack, or it can be used as a surprise attack to catch your opponent off guard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/f97967db38b154691928a1ab6d617ca26bd98b9e.png[/img]


[b][h3]■Build up your anger! [/h3][/b]
When Black Vinegar attacks or is attacked, the anger gauge is accumulated. When this gauge reaches the maximum, the hammer will change and the next normal attack or dash attack by the main skill will change. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/1c8a545de6a088301f55926ea3dd65be1c99a053.png[/img]

 　The seventh new fighter to be added is the cool samurai Takeo Sasaki. With his sword, he can slash through the wind with such speed that no one will be able to catch up with him.

The 4th new fighter addition will be "Hell Sauce" whose power increases with each damage.

He is a very popular "beverage" who has a lot of videos to drink when searching on a video posting site, and although he is small, he has the power to compete with its popularity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/b34a9ff16b052405e90ae563c69c26c2a2038195.png[/img]

■Increase power each time you take damage

The new fighter "Hell Sauce" is a unique fighter with the characteristic that the attack power increases each time it takes damage.

It is also possible to take damage by yourself with the sub skill, and you can continue to increase the attack power as long as your physical strength continues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39018532/cd2c0d7b83fcf25f8583ee3aa7126afa56f4cdef.png[/img]
